Standard: Air vehicle transparencies and all supporting structure withstands the impact of a 4-lb bird at an impact speed, in knots, without injurious deformation, penetration, or air vehicle loss. The transparency AW bird impact speed is determined for the air vehicle by a bird strike threat exposure. Impact speed calculations assume a 4-lb bird, 7000 ft AGL limit, and a probability of loss less than 1x10-7 . The impact does not result in loss of the air vehicle due to mechanical failure, penetration and spalling into the cockpit space, secondary projectiles (e.g., HUDs, rear-view mirrors) and deflection or object contact with the crewmember. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Determine the transparency AW bird impact speed by accomplishing a transparency bird strike threat exposure analysis. Assume a 4-lb bird, 7000 ft AGL limit, and a probability of loss less than 1X10-7 . Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct full-scale bird strike tests, IAW ASTM F330-21, at the transparency AW bird strike impact speed. Verify that the transparency and all supporting frame structure withstands impact without penetration, spalling, secondary projectiles and deformation impact to the crewmember, or loss of the air vehicle.
